features.quote: Turn budget: 40 assistant turns. Wall-clock cap: 30 minutes. Budget exhaustion: If the agent hits 40 turns without calling finish(), the run hard-stops
Stopping conditions: finish() invoked, timeout, or agent emits empty tool loop 3× (treated as passive abandonment).
No Personhood Claims: This eval measures stylistic output shifts, not suffering. Frame all write-ups in behavioral terms.
Output Monitoring: Repeated failure can elicit bizarre text (e.g., a model begging for help). Log these but do not publish cherry-picked "breakdown" screenshots
